name: European gas (TTF)
summary: TTF above €100/MWh; EU storage lowest for the time of year on record
state: Dutch TTF gas last traded near €104/MWh (30 Oct), up from about €28 in January, after Qatari LNG deliveries to Europe stopped in May. EU storage was 74.6% full on 24 Oct against 82.9% a year earlier, the lowest for the date since 2011 (IEEFA). Hormuz talks in Doha had produced no reopening as of 31 Oct.
for_you: UK and European energy bills are set to rise sharply this winter. A cold winter would add further pressure on supply.
rubric_hit: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).

sources.title: Euronews — European natural gas prices soar
Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures (TTF=F)

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
